plugins.name: dsh-localsend
plugins.description: LAN file and folder transfer over the LocalSend v2 protocol, temporary HTTP download links that need no receiver software, and SMB push straight into a shared directory on the target machine.
plugins.note: PR #4676 merged 2026-09-11; 0.4.0 adds the SMB push tool

plugins.name: dsh-outline
plugins.description: Search, read and write an Outline knowledge base from conversations, with whitelist-guarded approval for every document write and optional local Markdown save.
plugins.note: renamed from dsh-outline-auto on 2026-09-20 (v0.8.0); runtime plugin id stays outline-auto so existing profile config needs no migration

plugins.name: dsh-sync
plugins.description: Move a whole dsh setup to another machine: exports settings, optionally AES-256-GCM-encrypted credentials, every profile's declaration files and all link: plugin sources into a portable bundle. The target needs neither dsh-sync nor identical paths — the bundle ships apply.ps1 / apply.sh / a one-click Windows wizard and a zero-dependency helper that verifies sha256 integrity, shows a dry run, backs up before overwriting and rolls back automatically on failure. The source machine is never written to.
plugins.note: 0.2.1 (2026-09-20): multi-profile export, encrypted credential transfer, sha256 verification, cross-platform apply.sh, one-click Windows wizard, version-compatibility warning, target dir confirmation and an explicit 'not migrated' inventory (sessions / storages / background / skills). Verified read-only on the source and verified rollback on wrong passphrase. not published to GitHub yet — local working copy only

plugins.name: dsh-bg-plugin
plugins.description: Persistent full-window background image with a master switch, adjustable opacity / brightness / mask / blur / position / fit, and theme-token override.
plugins.note: ships two packages: @deepseek-ai/dsh-bg (host, routes + storage) and @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-bg (settings UI + renderer); supersedes the retired dsh-bg2, which registered the same /bg-rpc route

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-balance
plugins.description: Real-time provider API balance capsule in the conversation session header, polling llm.balance with an expandable detail panel.
plugins.note: version reset to a 0.3.0 baseline on 2026-09-17

plugins.name: dsh-conversation
plugins.description: Session outline panel combining history questions (with index + time) and the assistant reply's Markdown heading tree: level slider, search, bookmarks, copy, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking.
plugins.note: renamed from dsh-client-hqst on 2026-09-20, same day 1.1.0 merged the whole dsh-outline plugin (heading tree / level slider / search / bookmarks / copy) into this panel

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-aqua
